propositions: Staleness error messages incorrectly name 'description/AC/file_impact/children' as the material basis, but 'AC' is not a basis key and acceptance criteria live inside description only

Ticking an AC checkbox does not invalidate an attestation because _normalize_checkbox_state() rewrites checkboxes before hashing, but per-component hashes were never recorded to prove which input actually changed

The material basis is a composite SHA256 over exactly ticket_id, description, file_impact, children, and file_impact_scope (when scope is none), and per-component fingerprints must be signed in the manifest to enable component-wise diffing at read time

Pre-330c attestations hashed raw descriptions without normalization, causing false stale-material verdicts after checkbox edits even though the normalized basis is unchanged, hidden by the fixed-list message
Every attestation refusal surface must say WHAT CHANGED by component name with before/after counts, not recite a fictional list of inputs
